arStrings.szText:
Whenever you cast {c_important}Clash{/c}, gain Crusader's March for {c_number}{buffduration:BUFF_BLOCK}{/c} seconds.

Crusader's March grants you {c_number}[SF_4*100|%x|]{/c} Block Chance and {c_number}[SF_27]{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.

You are emboldened during Crusader's March, granting:
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_number}[{SF_11} * 100|+%|]{/c} {c_important}{u}Retribution{/u}{/c} Chance
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_number}[{SF_26}]{/c} Thorns
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_number}[{SF_7} * 100|%x|]{/c} Thorns damage

{c_important}Clash{/c} becomes a {c_important}Zealot{/c} Skill and cleaves in an area for {c_number}{payload:MELEE_DAMAGE_B}{/c} damage.

Crusaders March no longer grants Block Chance or {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, instead granting {c_number}[{SF_20} * 100|+%|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance up to {c_number}[{SF_22} * 100|+%|]{/c}.

Your {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} empowers {c_important}Clash{/c}, dealing {c_number}[{SF_12} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_39}]{/c} stacks.

Every 3rd strike, enemies are Pulled in.
Striking an enemy with {c_important}Clash{/c} grants {c_number}[SF_27]{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
Increase the effect of Crusader's March by {c_number}[{SF_36} * 100|%x|]{/c}
